title: Comparing Segment and Dimension Setup between Dynamics GP and Dynamics Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: Introduction to segments and accounts in GP
Account format and segment setup in GP
Migration overview from GP to Business Central
Global and shortcut dimensions in Business Central
General ledger setup and dimensions configuration
Chart of accounts migration and analysis

features.name: Global Dimensions
features.description: Business Central has two Global Dimensions that should be the most common segments from GP, allowing easy sorting and filtering on transaction categorization.
caveats: Limited to two global dimensions; additional segments become shortcut dimensions

features.name: Shortcut Dimensions
features.description: Remaining segments from GP beyond the two Global Dimensions are migrated as shortcut dimensions in Business Central for additional categorization.

features.name: Cloud Migration Setup Wizard
features.description: Wizard that allows users to select which segments from GP should be migrated as Global Dimensions in Business Central.

features.name: Dimension values migration
features.description: Segment values from GP are automatically migrated over as dimension values in Business Central during the migration process.

quotes.text: categorize revenue by region and market segment and expenses by department and projects

quotes.text: in the cloud migration Setup Wizard you can indicate which segments you would like to be Global Dimensions
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key migration mechanism for converting GP segments into Business Central dimensions.

quotes.text: Business Central has two Global Dimensions these should be the most common segments as you can easily sort and filter on these Dimensions
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the structural limit and design principle for global dimensions in Business Central.

quotes.text: The remainder of your segments will be migrated as shortcut dimensions in business Central
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies how GP segments beyond the two global dimensions are handled in the migration.
